summary: Inspected LeanBridge/ForMathlib/Irreduciblepolys/PolynomialsAsLists.lean (45889 bytes). This file contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of polynomial operations on lists (addPointwise, convolve, dropTrailingZeros), conversion functions between lists and Mathlib polynomials (ofList, toList, toList'), proofs that these form an isomorphism, lemmas about degrees/coefficients/leading coefficients, and a computable polynomial subtype with a full ring isomorphism to R[X]. This is core formal mathematics, not tooling or process code.
